lines = ["# Status", "", "| Service | State |", "|---|---|"]
lines += [f"| {row['name']} | {row['state']} |" for row in sorted(inputs["services"], key=lambda row: row["name"])]
result = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
root = ET.fromstring(inputs["xml"])
result = [{"id": node.attrib["id"], "text": node.text} for node in root.findall("item") if node.attrib.get("active") == "true"]

from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urlsplit, urlunsplit
parts = urlsplit(inputs["url"])
query = urlencode(sorted(parse_qsl(parts.query)))
result = urlunsplit((parts.scheme.lower(), parts.netloc.lower(), parts.path, query, ""))

from pathlib import PurePosixPath
result = [{"source": path, "target": str(PurePosixPath(path).with_suffix(".json"))} for path in sorted(inputs["paths"]) if PurePosixPath(path).suffix in {".yaml", ".toml"}]
result = market.get_price(symbol=inputs["symbol"])

record = catalog.lookup(sku=inputs["sku"])
result = shipping.quote(city=record["city"], weight_kg=record["weight_kg"])

prices = [market.get_price(symbol=symbol)["price"] for symbol in inputs["symbols"]]
result = {"max": max(prices), "total": sum(prices)}
